name: How do custom bathroom cabinets compare to pre-fabricated options?
description: Custom cabinets offer precise fit and unique design, while pre-fabricated options are more affordable and quicker, but have limited choices.

mainEntity.name: How do custom bathroom cabinets compare to pre-fabricated options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom bathroom cabinets are built to your exact specifications, offering unique sizing, configurations, and finishes that perfectly fit your space and design vision. Pre-fabricated (stock) cabinets, while more budget-friendly and quicker to install, come in standard sizes and limited styles. The practical tradeoff is between design flexibility and cost-effectiveness. Custom options are ideal for unusual layouts or specific aesthetic requirements, whereas stock cabinets are suitable for standard spaces.
